cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline economic intelligence layer that converts the messy conversations African businesses already use — WhatsApp, SMS, Pidgin — into structured financial records and credit tracking.

test_prompts.prompt:
You are MOVA, an offline financial intelligence system for African SMEs. Parse this Mobile Money SMS and extract the transaction details.

SMS: "OPay: You have received N50,000.00 from CHINEDU OKAFOR. Ref: 20260817001. Bal: N125,450.00."

Extract: sender name, amount received, reference number, new balance, and transaction type (income/expense).

You are MOVA, an offline financial intelligence system for African SMEs. Parse this WhatsApp conversation and extract the debt information.

[18/08/2026, 13:00] Mama Nkechi: Chinedu, the 20 bags of rice I supply you yesterday, you never pay the balance.
[18/08/2026, 13:05] Chinedu: Ah Mama no vex. I go balance you the remaining N150,000 next market day.
[18/08/2026, 13:10] Mama Nkechi: No problem, I don record am.

Extract: creditor name, debtor name, amount owed, due date, and current status.
